command_type.description: The unshield command to execute: extract (x), list (l), test (t), components (c), or groups (g)

input_cab_file.description: The path to the InstallShield CAB file to act upon

output_directory.description: The directory to extract files to (only for 'extract' command)

force_version.description: Force InstallShield version number (only for 'extract' command, e.g., '4')

debug_level.description: Debug log level: 0 (No logging), 1 (Errors only), 2 (Errors and warnings), 3 (Errors, warnings and debug messages)

lower_case_names.description: Make file and directory names lowercase (-L flag)

junk_paths.description: Junk paths (do not make directories) (-j flag)

raw_data.description: Save raw data (do not decompress) (-r flag)

no_conversion.description: Don't do any conversion to file and directory names when extracting (-R flag)

file_group.description: Only list/extract this file group (-g flag)
